raw_response: {"diagnosis": "Raw `raw_transactions` holds 27 txn_ids delivered twice, with record_version 1 and 2 carrying different amounts. The silver step filters on status but never deduplicates, so both versions flow into silver and gold. Deduplicating to the latest record_version before the POSTED filter is the standard supersede rule; the 25 duplicate keys in silver (not 27) fit with a few superseded versions being REVERSED.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.72, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM (SELECT * FROM raw_transactions QUALIFY row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY txn_id ORDER BY record_version DESC, batch_id DESC) = 1) latest WHERE status = 'POSTED';"}}
